label: Any two successors of the selected world are mutually accessible
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: any two worlds accessible from the selected world w access one another. Under the alethic reading, any two histories possible relative to the actual history are possible relative to each other. It is global Euclidean access restricted to the one world w; nothing is said about what a merely possible history accesses beyond the other successors of w.
